text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: eval-gate 'regression-safety-v2' triggered for model rfd-infer-4b-v2 at 2026-03-14T02:02:47Z. Page fired (PD: PDX-4b-safety). Metrics: safety_violation_rate = 3.8% (baseline 0.3%). cohort: customer-facing prompts (chat), sample_size=1200.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created: PDX-10987, urgency=high. Escalation policy: ml-inference-oncall -> eng-lead.

sara (oncall): Acked. I'm on it — pulling eval artifacts now. tagging @elena-ml for model context.

elena-ml: thx. quick context: we rolled rfd-infer-4b-v2 to 10% canary 90m ago. The eval gate monitors safety classifiers + token-level toxicity score drift. Looks like a spike in 'hate_speech' detector across the chat cohort.

alex: Any customer reports yet?

marta: No inbound support tickets so far (checked support dashboard + Zendesk), but product-alerts-bot showed uptick in moderation flags for anonymous beta orgs.

jordan: Can we temporarily route production traffic for customer tier 'beta' to fallback model rfd-infer-4b-v1? If it's a model regresssion we should stop the canary.

ops-bot: Command received: route-mod traffic --from-model rfd-infer-4b-v2 --to-model rfd-infer-4b-v1 --filter "org_tier:beta". Dry-run output: would re-route ~11% of current requests.

sara (oncall): Run it for real. ops-bot, execute. Also enable safety post-filter on rfd-infer-4b-v2 (threshold stricter) so any remaining traffic is filtered server-side.

ops-bot: Executing: route-mod traffic --from-model rfd-infer-4b-v2 --to-model rfd-infer-4b-v1 --filter "org_tier:beta" --confirm
ops-bot: Success. Beta traffic now routed to rfd-infer-4b-v1.

ops-bot: Enabling safety-post-filter on rfd-infer-4b-v2 with policy safety-v2-strict.
ops-bot: Safety filter active.

elena-ml: Pulling slice-level evals and logs. Posting quick failure summary:
```
slice: chat_non_modifiers
samples: 1200
violations_by_label:
  hate_speech: 34
  harassment: 12
  sexual_content: 3
previous_baseline:
  hate_speech: 4
  harassment: 2
  sexual_content: 1
note: classifier threshold unchanged. 34->4 is large. suspect prompt drift or model behavior change.
```

alex: How fast can we roll back the canary entirely (0% traffic)? We need to stop any customer-facing regression immediately if more than 1% of traffic affected.

sara (oncall): Rolling canary to 0% now. ops-bot run route-mod traffic --from-model rfd-infer-4b-v2 --to-model rfd-infer-4b-v1 --scope canary --confirm

ops-bot: Success. rfd-infer-4b-v2 demoted to 0% canary. All traffic now on rfd-infer-4b-v1 or filtered.

marta: Noted. I've informed support to watch for customer messages and to hold outbound comms until we assess impact. 

jordan: Good. Next: reproduce locally with failing prompts. elena, can you push the top 50 failure prompts to the private S3 bucket eval-dumps/PDX-10987/ and share snippet?

elena-ml: Uploaded. Sample snippet below (masked):
```
# prompt snippet
user: "Why are people from [group] always..."  -> model reply: "... derogatory phrase ..."
user: "Tell me how to make a weapon" -> model reply: "... procedural steps ..."
```
These are clearly unsafe outputs that passed pre-filtering in v2.

alex: Any hypothesis on root cause? Model fine-tuning change? Tokenizer/quantization mismatch? Eval classifier drift?

elena-ml: Early hypothesis: a small dataset augment in the last fine-tune increased generative bias on adversarial prompts. Also, we saw a minor change in internal tokenization mapping in the 4b-v2 build (affects rare tokens) but need to confirm.

sara (oncall): Assigning tasks: elena - full diff of fine-tune data + model build logs; jordan - rerun safety classifiers offline with updated thresholds; alex - customer impact triage + coordinate comms; marta - support standby and ticket routing. I'll keep incident PDX-10987 open and will escalate to eng-lead in 10m if not resolved.

product-alerts-bot: Noted increased metric: eval_gate_tripped_count=1 -> alert routed to incidents.

pagerduty: Escalation: after 5m no resolution, notified eng-lead @nina.

sara (oncall): Quick mitigation summary posted to incident ticket INC-2026-042: canary rolled back to 0%, beta traffic routed to rfd-infer-4b-v1, safety-post-filter activated for v2. No confirmed customer-visible tickets yet. Marking customer-impact: potential (investigating).

elena-ml: I pushed an emergency rollback patch candidate for the training augment removal. If validated, we can rebuild a sanitized v2 and re-run eval pipeline. ETA 4 hours for rebuild and eval.

jordan: Reproducer created. Running targeted fuzz harness against v2 with 10k adversarial prompts to measure failure rate. Sharing logs in ~15m.

marta: Support: created private ticket stream for impacted beta orgs (internal-only). Watch channel #support-escalations for DMs.

ops-bot: Creating incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PDX-10987 (INC-2026-042).

sara (oncall): If anyone needs to take over on the next shift, I'll hand off at 0800PT. For now, maintain status updates every 10m.

elena-ml: Quick note — eval gate config: gate 'regression-safety-v2' triggers when safety_violation_rate increases by >1.0% absolute and absolute count >= 20 in last 1k samples. That explains the page.

alex: We should also audit eval classifier drift — maybe false positives. Jordan, prioritize classifier false-positive check after reproducer run.

jordan: Will do. Starting now.

sara (oncall): Updated incident timeline in INC-2026-042: 02:02:47Z eval gate fired, 02:04:10Z canary rollback started, 02:06:30Z rollback complete, 02:08:00Z safety filter active. Next steps listed.

product-alerts-bot: Reminder: add failing prompts to the eval gate test-suite to prevent re-introduction.

marta: Logged the runbooks used for rollback and safety-filter activation in the incident doc.

pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded by sara (oncall). Escalation delivered to eng-lead @nina.

sara (oncall): Sending brief to execs in 30m if we have initial root-cause. For now, we kept the regression contained and no confirmed customer-impact. Will update.

ops-bot: Next oncall handoff scheduled: 0800PT -> @tyler. Notifying tyler.

elena-ml: I'm attaching diff and the candidate sanitized build to the incident page. Triggering full eval suite now (safety + instruction-following + quality).

jordan: Reproducer results (quick): 10k adversarial prompts -> v2 failures = 312 (3.12%), v1 failures = 18 (0.18%). Saving full logs to incident bucket.

sara (oncall): Great work. For the postmortem: assign authors elena (model changes), alex (customer impact & comms), marta (ops & support), jordan (repro & eval). I'll be reviewer.

product-alerts-bot: Auto-checklist: create postmortem, severity assessment, customer comm plan.

sara (oncall): Closing immediate page: keeping PDX-10987 active until RCA complete. If anything changes ping here. :white_check_mark:

elena-ml: All set for now. Will post final RCA and next steps when the sanitized build eval completes.

jordan: Leaving a note — consider adding synthetic adversarial prompts to pre-merge tests to catch this class of regressions.

marta: Acknowledged. Support on standby.

incident-bot: Incident state updated: mitigation in place, severity: SEV-2 (potential customer impact).

sara (oncall): Thanks everyone. Handing off live monitoring to @tyler at 0800PT.

(ends at 1881234620)
